Synthetic documented Claude Code SDK stream fixture, CLI producer baseline 2.1.309, reviewed 2026-10-25. Primary sources: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/streaming-output and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/typescript . No immutable docs commit is published. Coverage: per-block complete messages sharing upstream message ID, distinct SDK UUIDs, partial stream envelopes, tool-use/result join, failed result, compaction boundary and final result/usage. Additional synthetic tests cover interrupted calls, forwarded agent IDs, task runs, child links, duplicate delivery, safe details, unsupported histories and unknown records. No real transcript. Prospective SDK stream only; no private history reader or universal version promise. Content-block stop ends generation, not tool execution. BashOutput has no documented exit code: incidental exit_code is ignored. Message timestamps are content-generation completion, not tool start/end.

Identity policy: native identity keys are scoped to the explicitly supplied capture plus session/thread and, for Claude, agent. Local slugs follow first recognized display order. Only bounded ASCII identifier tokens are retained as metadata; recognized credential assignments are rejected from identifiers. Missing versions warn, untested numeric versions in the same major warn, and other majors/version spellings fail. Unknown additive fields are ignored; unknown kinds warn. Details are excluded unless explicitly enabled and are sanitized before event construction. Redaction is incomplete: inspect local output before submission. No token/cost accounting, test-success inference, inferred timing, automatic child discovery, agent execution or network access.
